title: FAIRGate: Agentic Runtime Policy Selection and Verified Repair for Fairer Recommendation Delivery
abstract: arXiv:2610.30359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fairness-aware recommender systems often encode one fairness objective during training or apply a fixed re-ranking rule after scoring. In deployment, however, the appropriate fairness action can vary across requests because the candidate pool, item metadata, exposure debt, user preference history, and utility budget all change at runtime. We propose FAIRGate, a model-agnostic delivery controller that places an agentic policy-selection layer between a base ranker and the final top-K list. The agent does not define fairness objectives from scratch. It chooses from a predefined policy library covering long-tail exposure, item-group exposure balance, concentration control, calibration protection, and abstention. A deterministic executor then applies the selected policy through constrained repair, and a validator accepts the result only when relevance, feasibility, metadata, calibration, and audit constraints are satisfied. translated_title: FAIRGate：面向更公平推荐分发的智能体化运行时策略选择与可验证修复
translated_abstract: 公平感知的推荐系统通常在训练阶段编码单一公平性目标，或在评分后应用固定的重排序规则。然而在部署阶段，合适的公平性操作可能因请求而异，因为候选池、物品元数据、曝光债务、用户偏好历史和效用预算都会在运行时发生变化。我们提出FAIRGate，一个模型无关的分发控制器，它在基础排序器和最终top-K列表之间放置了一个智能体化的策略选择层。该智能体并非从头定义公平性目标，而是从一个预定义的策略库中进行选择，该策略库涵盖长尾曝光、物品组曝光均衡、集中度控制、校准保护和弃权等策略。随后，一个确定性执行器通过受限修复来应用所选策略，并且只有在相关性、可行性、元数据、校准和审计约束均得到满足时，验证器才会接受该结果。（注：原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: FAIRGate提出了一种模型无关的推荐分发控制器，通过智能体在运行时从预定义的公平策略库中动态选择合适策略，并借助确定性执行与多重约束验证的修复机制，实现更公平且可审计的推荐结果分发。
en_tdlr: FAIRGate is a model-agnostic delivery controller that uses an agent to dynamically select the appropriate fairness policy from a predefined library at runtime, and then applies deterministic constrained repair with multi-constraint validation to ensure fairer and auditable recommendation delivery.
